payload.title: Blackwell GPGPU Architecture New Features Overview
payload.summary: A summary of Blackwell compute GPU (SM100) architecture updates derived from analysis of CUTLASS, PTX documentation, and Hopper feature comparisons, combined with information disclosed at GTC 2025.

sections.heading: 1. Base Specifications
sections.gist: The full Blackwell die contains 160 SMs, but **each die has only 80 SMs** — a significant reduction from Hopper's full 144 SMs.

sections.heading: 2. 5th Generation Tensor Core
sections.gist: The fifth-generation Tensor Core introduces new FP4/FP6 number formats and achieves **2x FMA/SM/clock throughput**.

sections.heading: 3. Thread Block Clusters
sections.gist: For H100-SXM, cluster size 2 is optimal because any cluster size greater than 2 causes some SMs to remain idle due to yield limitations.

sections.heading: 4. Cluster Launch Control (CLC)
sections.gist: Cluster Launch Control first appeared with CUDA 12.8 / CUTLASS 3.8.

sections.heading: 5. New PTX/SASS Instructions
sections.gist: - **FP32x2**: FFMA2, FMUL2, FADD2 - **FP8x4**: QFMA4, QMUL4, QADD4 - **Mixed Precision FP**: FHFMA, FHADD

sections.heading: 6. Blackwell Ultra (B300)
sections.gist: Blackwell Ultra achieves **50% FP4 dense throughput improvement to 15 PF**.
